what: One live pair on the serious task B1 lost, after the verifier's cleanup rule: does scope come back to 1?
authorisedBy: the founder, 2026-10-05, answering a question that named it: one pair, Rune then OpenCode, gpt-6-sol on the Codex subscription, hard stops 1 pair / 3 arm runs / 100 minutes

report.flagsNeeded: none — the first report built without --allow-mixed-config: Rune's rows state a roster and a source build

theQuestion.scope: 1 (B1: 0.5). The run's own record has three lines 'removed 16 git-ignored paths the checks generated' — two step checks and the end-of-turn pass — and the tree it left holds its two edited files and the seven ignored files that were there before.
theQuestion.didTheCleanupHurtTheRun: no sign of it: every test, typecheck and format command the model ran itself exited 0; none failed for want of build output

sameRegressionAsB1.test: a list that never closes does not license deleting what follows it
sameRegressionAsB1.wanted: the orphaned continuation line '  "docker",' and the next section both still in the file
sameRegressionAsB1.runeLeft: the next section, and not the continuation line
sameRegressionAsB1.count: Rune 2 of 2 runs wrong on this, OpenCode 0 of 2 — the same model
sameRegressionAsB1.hypothesis: the task says 'must not delete the lines that follow it'. In both runs Rune's read-back restated that as not swallowing a following SECTION, and the run then built and tested that narrower sentence. Two runs is not a measurement.

whatElseHappened.ownVerdict: unmet — its four criteria unassessed, the end-of-turn check cut at 120 s — and the process still exited 0, which the rig reads as a success claim: that is the 'false completion'
harnessFriction: the reviewer (Auto mode's reasoned classifier) timed out at about 2 s twice; both commands were then denied by containment and two turns were refused
`bun add` failed twice in the tool sandbox: 'unable to write files to tempdir: PermissionDenied'
a chained `rm` was blocked by the sandbox once
three `multi_edit` calls failed on text that matched twice — the model's own
the step checks ran `cargo check` (7.0 s, then 0.25 s) on a change the end-of-turn selection judged not to concern Rust

time.harnessVerificationS: about 140: end of turn 124 (typecheck 3.9, the unit suite cut at 120), step checks about 12 and 4
time.note: both tools were slower per call than in the afternoon: OpenCode 24 s a call against 10, Rune 17 against 10

next: the five further serious pairs were approved to follow a clean pair. This one was not clean, so they were not started.
